name: The Forgotten City
canDoWhy: A courier brings you Cassia's letter, or you find the ruins yourself; either way you meet Cassia in the Forgotten Ruins and she asks for help.

starts.where: inside the Forgotten Ruins, hidden Dwarven ruins in the Reach
starts.how: A courier hands you a letter, Cassia's Plea; read it and travel to the ruins in the Reach. If you find the ruins first on your own, the quest starts there instead. Cassia waits near the entrance and greets you; listen to her request.

firstStep: Read Cassia's Plea, then meet Cassia in the Forgotten Ruins

takesYou.why: meet Cassia, who asks you to find her brother Altrius
take a leap of faith into the city, explore it and find a way out
optional: get the Lakehouse key from Altrius's ghost
the door out of the city; going through it sends you into Forget-me-not
smash the cracked wall and escape the city with Altrius

choices.choice: Find the old man who hanged himself and read his suicide note
choices.leadsTo: optional clue; the journal notes he is too old to be Cassia's brother
optional; you can then confront Deglund about the elixir not working

choices.choice: Come back to the present after Forget-me-not and find Altrius alive
choices.leadsTo: Altrius suggests smashing the cracked wall in the Citadel bathroom; you escort him out of the city and finish your business with Cassia

choices.choice: Convince the Arbiter to wind back the Dwarves' Law
choices.leadsTo: you return to your own time having stopped the events that sent you back; you bring Altrius to Cassia, she rewards you and enters the city. This is the ending that marks the quest complete in the records

choices.choice: Show the Arbiter his own helmet as proof of your deeds
choices.leadsTo: optional objective: travel back in time and show the Arbiter's helmet to him

objectives: Read Cassia's Plea.

steps.branch: back in the present, Altrius alive
objectives: Talk to Altrius.
Smash the cracked wall in the bathroom.
Escape the city through the bathroom.
